categories.main_business_segments: Changchun Zhiyuan New Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of vehicle-mounted LNG supply systems, LNG-powered ship fuel systems, low-temperature storage tanks, and lithium-ion battery anode material graphitization products. The company serves heavy trucks, engineering vehicles, river and ocean vessels, and the lithium-ion battery industry. It also engages in hydrogen energy equipment manufacturing through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in LNG gas cylinder design and manufacturing, including vacuum insulation, lightweight materials, and intelligent manufacturing systems. It employs high-temperature graphitization processes (2800-3000°C) for lithium battery anode materials to enhance electrochemical stability. Production methods include integrated R&D, strict supplier management, precision manufacturing, and digitalized smart factory operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic commercial vehicle manufacturers such as FAW Jiefang, Dongfeng Commercial Vehicle, Foton Daimler, and Shaanxi Heavy Duty Automobile. The markets served are primarily heavy-duty LNG trucks, engineering vehicles, LNG-powered ships (river and ocean), and lithium-ion battery manufacturers for new energy vehicles and energy storage sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with manufacturing bases and offices in Jilin Province (Changchun, Daan, Taonan), Suzhou, Wuhan, and other locations. Its products serve domestic heavy truck and shipbuilding industries, with some export activities implied in LNG storage and ship fuel systems.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhiyuan New Energy operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and direct sales of LNG supply systems and related equipment. It is a key supplier to vehicle manufacturers and shipbuilders, integrating upstream raw materials through its subsidiaries’ production of lithium battery anode materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in lightweight design, long-duration vacuum insulation, high-pressure gas supply modules, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D focuses on enhancing product performance, cost reduction, and expanding into hydrogen energy equipment. It maintains close collaboration with universities and research institutes to sustain technological leadership and develop new energy vehicle components.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of manufactured products including vehicle-mounted LNG supply systems, LNG ship fuel systems, low-temperature storage tanks, and lithium battery anode material processing services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns, with no subscription or licensing revenue reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhiyuan New Energy is a leading domestic manufacturer in the vehicle-mounted LNG supply system market, holding a top market share since 2018. It competes in a highly competitive and rapidly evolving industry with multiple domestic suppliers expanding capacity. Its subsidiary Suzhou Zhibang is recognized among top LNG ship fuel system suppliers in China, competing with firms like China International Marine Containers and Hopu Co.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.15 billion, a 35.18% decrease from 2023, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 192 million. Total assets were RMB 2.23 billion, down 12.21% year-over-year. The company faces profitability challenges due to intense market competition and lower product prices but continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhiyuan New Energy differentiates itself through advanced technology, high product quality, and comprehensive customer service. Its intelligent manufacturing base and continuous innovation in lightweight, high-vacuum LNG cylinders and integrated supply modules provide superior performance and cost advantages. The company’s strong customer relationships with leading vehicle manufacturers and its certifications as a high-tech and green factory reinforce its competitive edge.
